scripts.title: Europium Christmas gift opener
scripts.features:
Allows you to open christmas gifts automatically. Making this public and open source because i dont see a reason to gatekeep it.

Avoid setting the delay too low.
scripts.script:
-- europiumproject.space

local delay = 0.1 -- delay per gift
local amountoftimes = 100 -- how many gifts to open

for i= 1,amountoftimes do 
    task.wait(delay)
    game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("Remotes"):WaitForChild("XMasReward"):InvokeServer()
end
